messages:
marie: quick thread — want to sync on the community tutorial + benchmark launch sequence for next month
devon: 👍 can we pair the tutorial (refapp walk-through) with a short live demo webinar? low-friction CTA to the repo
samir: yes — suggestion: publish benchmark blog + notebook first, then webinar the week after so we can point to data in the demo
lia: timeline check — blog live 2/12, notebook and sample data 2/13, webinar 2/20? that gives us 1 week to gather prereg questions
jess: sounds good. who owns the notebook PR? I can take it but need dev resources for the synthetic dataset job
devon: @jess i'll allocate 2 dev hours this week to help with data pipeline + README examples
marie: marketing assets: launch post, short social thread, 1 pager for partners, and a webinar landing page. I'll draft the landing copy and social blurbs by Mon
samir: benchmark narrative: focus on latency/cost tradeoffs, show batching & caching impact, include a simple table: `model | quant | tokens/sec | $/1M tokens`
lia: for the notebook, include a small script to reproduce the main numbers: ```python
# run benchmark
from redwood_bench import run
run(model='rw-medium', seq=512, batch=8)
```
jess: love that — add a small section on "how we measured" (env, seed, warmup) so it's reproducible
marie: webinar format idea: 30m demo (refapp + benchmark highlights), 15m Q&A, optional breakout rooms for hands-on. Registrants get the notebook repo link + quickstart credits
devon: AV ops: we'll need a producer for the live demo, + recorded backup. @deploy-bot can we schedule a recording room?
deploy-bot: created calendar event "Refapp + Benchmark Webinar" on 2026-02-20 16:00 UTC with recording enabled — invites sent to marie, devon, samir, lia, jess
samir: inbound routing: capture signups in HubSpot with tags: "webinar-refapp-2-20", "notebook-download"; marketing team to add nurture sequence (3 emails)
marie: email plan: pre-launch (announce + blog link), reminder 1 (3 days before), reminder 2 (day-of), post-webinar follow-up with repo + eval checklist
lia: can we also add a short survey in the follow-up about use-case (search, agent, assist) — will help with Optimize recommendations
jess: gating: notebook download requires email. grabbing repo is public but we'll provide a pre-filled GH issue template for feedback
devon: ops note — make sure Dedicated customers have a private link option if they request an on-prem variant in the form
marie: tasks:
- marie: landing + social copy (due Mon)
- jess: notebook + reproducibility section (due Fri)
- devon: infra + AV (today/tomorrow)
- samir: benchmark writeup (draft Thu)
- lia: survey + partner 1-pager (next Wed)
Please add PRs to the `community-launch` repo and prefix branch names with `webinar/`
samir: can we run a quick internal dry-run 2/17? 30 min to smoke test scripts and slides
marie: yes. locking 2/17 16:00 UTC for dry-run — invite will go out. any objections?
jess: none from me. will try to get the notebook early review done before dry-run
devon: i'll be on the dry-run to handle any runtime hiccups
marie: tiny ask on messaging — emphasize "production-grade inference" and "easy reproducibility" in the blog headline and webinar opener
lia: noted. will draft partner one-pager with those hooks and a short diagram of the flow (hosted -> dedicated -> private)
marie: awesome. tagging follow-ups in Asana after this thread. thanks team! :rocket:
